mungbean.name: Mungbean
mungbean.description: Legume crop sensitive to pod borers, aphids, and moisture stress during flowering/podding.

chemical.timing: Early morning spray at first cluster appearance

organic_biocontrol.timing: Spray late afternoon on undersides of leaves

recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear rubber gloves and face mask. Highly toxic to bees; do NOT spray during peak bloom pollination hours.

chemical.timing: Spray at flower bud initiation before larvae enter pods

recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear protective coveralls and goggles. Avoid application near irrigation ponds or fish sanctuaries.

chemical.timing: Foliar spray when nymphs are active

recommendations.safety_precautions: Do not breathe spray mist. Wash skin thoroughly after handling.

chemical.timing: Spray foliage thoroughly on upper and lower surfaces

recommendations.safety_precautions: Avoid runoff into drainage canals. Use designated chemical gloves.

squash.name: Squash / Cucurbits
squash.description: Vining vegetable vulnerable to squash bugs, vine borers, and fruit flies.

chemical.timing: Target base of vines and undersides of lower leaves where adults hide

organic_biocontrol.dosage: Dust powder around root collar or spray 1 ml/L Pyrethrin
organic_biocontrol.timing: Direct contact spray on egg clusters and young nymphs

recommendations.safety_precautions: Toxic to fish and aquatic invertebrates. Wear protective rubber boots, apron, and respirator.

chemical.product_name: Malathion 57% EC with Protein Hydrolysate Bait
chemical.dosage: 1.5 ml Malathion + 10 g Protein Bait per Liter of water
chemical.timing: Spot spray foliage (not fruit directly) as attractant bait

organic_biocontrol.product_name: Cue-lure Pheromone Traps & Spinosad Bait Spray
organic_biocontrol.dosage: 1 ml/L Spinosad; place 1 trap per 100 sq meters

recommendations.safety_precautions: Toxic to honeybees. Never spray open blossoms. Store bait traps out of reach of children.

chemical.timing: Direct spray exclusively along the main stem at soil line

organic_biocontrol.dosage: Apply nematode drench to stem bases with watering can
organic_biocontrol.timing: Apply on damp soil at dusk

recommendations.safety_precautions: Do not contaminate water supplies. Wear eye protection.

chemical.timing: Foliar coverage when feeding notches appear on seedling leaves

organic_biocontrol.timing: Coat leaves until white residue forms

recommendations.safety_precautions: Avoid breathing dust or spray mist. Wash thoroughly with soap.

eggplant.name: Eggplant
eggplant.description: Solanaceous vegetable highly susceptible to shoot borers and flea beetles.

chemical.timing: Spray at first sign of drooping shoots or small boreholes

organic_biocontrol.product_name: Pheromone Traps (Lucinlure) + Clip & Burn Wilted Shoots
organic_biocontrol.dosage: Place 1 lure trap per 150 sq meters; sanitize weekly
organic_biocontrol.timing: Continuous throughout vegetative and fruiting cycle

recommendations.safety_precautions: Prune and safely dispose of infested shoots before chemical spraying. Wear protective mask and gloves.

chemical.timing: Spray seedlings and lower foliage thoroughly

organic_biocontrol.product_name: Neem Cake Soil Amendment + Insecticidal Soap
organic_biocontrol.dosage: 200 g Neem cake per plant; 10 ml/L soap spray

recommendations.safety_precautions: Toxic to pollinators. Spray in late evening when bees are not foraging.

chemical.timing: Spray translaminar product on leaves showing serpentine mines

organic_biocontrol.dosage: Deploy sticky yellow cards at canopy height

recommendations.safety_precautions: Extremely toxic to aquatic organisms. Prevent water body runoff.

chemical.timing: Direct nozzle toward undersides of leaves where webbing occurs

organic_biocontrol.dosage: 2-3 g Sulfur per Liter of water
organic_biocontrol.timing: Do not apply when temperatures exceed 32Â°C (90Â°F) to avoid leaf burn

recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear dust mask when measuring wettable powders. Wash hands and exposed skin.

corn.name: Corn / Maize
corn.description: Cereal crop vulnerable to Fall Armyworm, Corn Borers, and ear feeding pests.

chemical.product_name: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG
chemical.dosage: 0.4 ml/L Chlorantraniliprole OR 0.4 g/L Emamectin Benzoate
chemical.timing: Target the corn whorl funnel directly during early vegetative growth

organic_biocontrol.product_name: Spodoptera frugiperda Multiple Nucleopolyhedrovirus (SfMNPV) or Bt
organic_biocontrol.dosage: 1-2 ml/L bio-virus or 2 g/L Bt kurstaki applied inside leaf whorls
organic_biocontrol.timing: Apply late afternoon into the funnel

recommendations.safety_precautions: Wear full PPE including chemical respirator and rubber gloves. Never spray upwind.

chemical.timing: Apply at tasseling before larvae bore into stalks

organic_biocontrol.dosage: Release 50-70 Trichocards per hectare at 7-day intervals
organic_biocontrol.timing: Release at first moth flight detection

recommendations.safety_precautions: Do not apply within 50 meters of freshwater streams or apiaries.

chemical.timing: Direct application to green silk zone as silks emerge

organic_biocontrol.product_name: Vegetable Mineral Oil + Bt Drop Method
organic_biocontrol.dosage: Apply 5 drops of oil/Bt mixture directly onto the tip of each ear silk
organic_biocontrol.timing: Apply once silks begin to turn brown

recommendations.safety_precautions: Avoid contact with skin, eyes, or clothing. Wash thoroughly.

chemical.timing: Foliar spray when upper leaves and tassels are encrusted with honeydew

organic_biocontrol.dosage: 5 ml per Liter of water with mild dish soap emulsifier

recommendations.safety_precautions: Organophosphate insecticide. Handle with extreme care using certified respirator.
